results.text: Assembly and cooperative mechanism of the hexameric fungal plasma membrane H The fungal plasma membrane H+-ATPase Pma1 hydrolyzes ATP to pump protons out of the cell to maintain the intracellular pH and membrane potential. Pma1 is unique among the P-type ATPases as it functions as a hexamer, although the underlying mechanism has been unclear. Vacuolar-type H+-ATPase (V-ATPase) is a crucial proton pump that plays an essential role in maintaining intracellular pH homeostasis and a variety of physiological processes.
